department: Biomedical Sciences Graduate Program (College of Medicine)

deadline.value: Apply by December 1 (strongly encouraged); the final deadline for international applicants is February 1. Entry is summer only.
deadline.quote: The final deadline for both U.S. and non-U.S./international applicants is February 1

gre_general.value: The GRE is no longer required.
gre_general.quote: No, as of 11/14/18, the GRE is no longer required.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 5.0 on the new scale (100 on the old scale).
toefl_min.quote: 5.0 or higher TOEFL iBT or iBT Home Edition (equivalent to 100 for tests taken prior to January 2026)

supervisor.value: International applicants must find a faculty member who commits to funding them for 5+ years before applying.
supervisor.quote: You must find a faculty member who commits to funding you for 5+ years before applying.

funding.value: Every accepted student is offered a stipend and full tuition and fee waiver; the advisor funds later years.
funding.quote: Every student accepted is offered an annual stipend and a full waiver of tuition and fees.

entry_route.value: The program offers only the PhD (no master's) and prefers a natural-sciences bachelor's.
entry_route.quote: Admission to the PhD program prefers an undergraduate degree in the natural sciences

gre_subject.value: Not stated on the pages checked

notes: College of Medicine program with summer-only entry; international admits are few unless a faculty mentor already commits funding.
